result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major performance/visual issue with an unloaded image and one minor layout concern with truncated text.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section is still loading, showing a visible spinner overlay instead of the actual restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Implement a proper skeleton/placeholder loading state that matches the image dimensions and style, or ensure images are preloaded before rendering the section. A blurred low-resolution placeholder (blur-up technique) would improve perceived performance.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) has its name abruptly cut off mid-word without an ellipsis, making it unclear to the user that the name continues.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis to restaurant name labels in card components so truncation is clearly indicated with '...' rather than a hard cut-off mid-character.
